Pale yellow slab in the centre assumed to be an egg frittata; it could instead be tofu, polenta or a cheese-based bake.
Grain assumed to be a red/brown rice or wild rice blend with corn kernels; logged under brown rice as the closest match.
Brown strands on the beef assumed to be caramelized onions.
Light oil-based dressing assumed from the sheen on the greens and grains; amount is not directly visible.
